behavior: Docs live in one tree under docs/ (map, system architecture, per-area architecture/rules/api/safety/design); every app and package AGENTS.md is a short pointer (what it is, commands, what to read); no CLAUDE.md files
acceptance: docs/README.md maps every doc; docs/architecture.md gives parts, who holds which key and the money flow (concepts, not folder maps)

docs/backend has architecture.md, rules.md (layout, naming, code, tests), api.md (contract-first OpenAPI, routes, JSON, money, idempotency, auth, errors, handler tests) and money-safety.md; docs/contracts has architecture.md, rules.md (every binding rule) and operations.md (Safe, Delay, Guard, deploys); docs/web has architecture.md, rules.md, DESIGN.md and PRODUCT.md (moved from apps/web) and images.md (images-check reads it)

apps/web, apps/backend, packages/contracts, packages/ui-web and packages/design-tokens each have an AGENTS.md of at most 20 lines that says what it is, its commands and which docs to read; no CLAUDE.md file remains (Claude Code reads AGENTS.md directly)

Root AGENTS.md (under 100 lines) has a where-to-look table and only repo-wide rules, harness block unchanged; PLAN.md and PROJECT.md link to the moved docs; no rule from the old AGENTS.md files or PLAN Phase 5/6 design is lost; all relative links resolve
keep: apps/web/src: comment-only changes (doc paths), no behavior change
notes: 2026-10-09 review fail by reviewer: Structure, links, lint, images-check, line limits, harness block and CLAUDE.md removal are fine (acceptance 1-3 met). Acceptance 4 fails: rules lost or changed. (1) docs/backend/api.md:25 replay returns 'the first response again' but R-19 says 201 first, 200 on replay. (2) docs/backend/rules.md lost HTTP server rules: ReadHeaderTimeout/ReadTimeout/WriteTimeout/IdleTimeout and http.MaxBytesReader; also lost .env.example lists every variable, missing-env error names every missing variable, embedded migrations NNNNN_name.sql, no pkg/, file naming; changed meaning: init() exception for driver registration dropped (:36), interfaces 'or two real implementations' dropped (:39), bare New narrowed to queries.New only (:29). (3) docs/contracts/operations.md:8-9 narrowed Safe deploy to planned chains; old rule also required every EVM chain where a wrong-chain deposit could arrive, before owner changes. (4) operations.md:13-18 lost 'with alerts' on Delay queue. (5) operations.md:33 says 'late invoices'; should be paid invoices pushed past the effective settle deadline (late is a defined state). (6) docs/contracts/rules.md:43-45 lost 'no gas cap on the invoice-token balance read (Tempo tokens need far more gas)'. (7) docs/contracts/architecture.md:24-25 says the recipient check lives in money-safety.md, but money-safety.md has no 'recipient = profile wallet from Privy, never user input' rule. (8) docs/backend/money-safety.md:27 canary lost 'takes the factory address from its own config'. (9) AGENTS.md:30-31 dropped 'imports flow constants -> types (type-only) -> code' (still in PLAN 3 only) and 'split when a folder mixes domains, in the same change'.

2026-10-09 Structure and backend audit only; existing F055 changes retained. Backend uncached race tests and build passed. Temporary fixtures reproduced stale verification after check-time edits and API shutdown cutting an active request; configured backend-e2e has no script and exits 0. Findings reported to owner; no implementation changes or delivery performed. F055 still awaits independent review.

2026-10-09 review pass by reviewer: Re-review: all 9 must-fix items fixed. api.md matches R-19 (201 first, 200 replay, 409 other body, 422, decimal-string amount next to chainId and token), server timeouts and MaxBytesReader back, /healthz exception noted. rules.md restores .env.example, NNNNN_name.sql, no pkg/, file naming, missing-variable error, init() driver exception, interfaces for two real implementations, original bare New rule. operations.md: Safe on every EVM chain where a wrong-chain deposit could arrive, queued-transaction alerts, pause line corrected. contracts rules.md: no gas cap (Tempo), getters settled and factory only on outside clones (matches InvoiceReceiver.sol), implementation in constructor, newest factory, refunds may repeat. money-safety.md: recipient from Privy wallet, canary uses its own config, deploy rule in the receive-address section. Root AGENTS.md: import flow and folder split back; 72 lines; harness block identical to main. No contradictions found. lint and images-check pass, 0 broken relative links, no project CLAUDE.md, the must-not-change list holds (apps/web/src comment-only).
